verdict.rationale: Marketing copy claims 'easy benefits admin' and PEO health insurance offering (justworks-docs-22, docs-8, docs-17), and payroll docs show general payroll accuracy checks and W-4-like enrollment data capture (docs-7, docs-9). However, no evidence specifically documents how health insurance enrollments and premium deductions are configured or synced into payroll processing — the payroll docs focus on custom reports, fringe benefits, and general accuracy checks, not health insurance deduction sync mechanics. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of health insurance enrollment workflow, deduction code mapping to payroll, and confirmation of automated sync between benefits elections and payroll runs.
